title: What is starting to make sense?
subtitle: A short review of the first week.
description: We have introduced pain, stress, recovery foundations, the thought–action loop, movement, and a first plan for difficult days. You do not need to master everything at once. These three questions help you identify what to build on.

sections.title: Explain one idea
sections.description: In your own words, explain why movement is part of recovery, or why pain intensity does not tell the whole story. If you are unsure, say what needs explaining.

fields.label: What is one idea you understand differently now?
fields.placeholder: Explain it as you would to someone at home, or write what still feels unclear.

sections.title: Notice what happened
sections.description: Think of one thing you tried: movement, a calming tool, or a small change to sleep, food, or hydration. No change, a difficult response, or not having tried yet are all useful to note.

fields.label: What did you try, and what did you notice?
fields.placeholder: What helped, did not help, or got in the way?

sections.title: Keep the conversation going
sections.description: We'll continue building your toolbox. You can use this question to guide your next appointment; completing this reflection does not send an urgent message.

fields.label: What would you like to ask or work on next?
fields.placeholder: One question or manageable next step is enough.

successMessage: Reflection complete. Keep your observations in mind for your next appointment.
